### AI: AI-assisted additions

- Written with Claude (Anthropic). Credit it in the annotated bibliography (see `CONTEXT.md`).
- Limits enforced by the checker: at most 25 CSS rules, 15 HTML elements, 0 scripts, and 6 declarations per rule, so every AI line could be typed by hand.
- Marked in the code with `@source AI` ... `@end AI`.

## Not site code

- tools/check_sources.py (the screening tool), .github/workflows/source-screen.yml and tools/hooks/pre-commit were written by Claude (Anthropic) on 2026-10-25. They check the site code; they are not part of the site.
- The layout and design decisions (which sources to combine, colors, sizes) were chosen by Claude working with the student.
